title: fix(react,app-shell,plugin-kanban,plugin-calendar): a standalone object-kanban / object-calendar honours the spec's `page` navigation, and a mode-less block, through the host's record navigator (objectui#11293)
body:
Fixes #11293
Clause-②: yes

## What this changes

A standalone `object-kanban` / `object-calendar` now honours the spec's `page` navigation mode, and a `navigation` block written without `mode` (which takes the spec's `page` default), by opening the record page. `drawer` and the other members behave as before, and a parent view's click handler still takes the click first.

The rule lives in ONE place, the shared hook, per triage's direction (comment 5922527918): no per-renderer copy, and no narrowing of the spec's mode set.

- **`@object-ui/react` — `useNavigationOverlay`.** In the `page` branch, when no `onNavigate` was supplied, the click goes to `openRecord(objectName, recordId)` on `RelatedRecordActionsContext`. That is the record navigator the HOST publishes, and the same seam the grid's link column and the lookup cells already read. The hook still builds no record URL for `page`. A supplied `onNavigate` still wins, so the grid keeps its explicit wiring. An `onRowClick` still takes the click before either.
- **`@object-ui/app-shell` — `PageView` publishes the console's record navigator to the blocks on a custom page.** This is the producer-side half (see "Where the fallback lives" below). It lives in the new module `views/pageRecordActions.ts`. `pageRecordActionsValue` addresses `/apps/APP/OBJECT/record/ID` for the objects the console routes to. `resolve` returns no related-list handlers, on the model of the list page's `listRecordActionsValue`.
- **`@object-ui/plugin-kanban` / `@object-ui/plugin-calendar`.** No renderer code changes: both already hand the hook their `navigation` and object name. The registrations' `navigation` input descriptions and docblocks retire the "page warning". They now say where `page` goes: through the host's record navigator, and nowhere under a host that publishes none. The READMEs, `content/docs/plugins/plugin-kanban.mdx`, `plugin-calendar.mdx` and `content/docs/api/schema-reference.md` follow.
- **Pins.** `kanbanNavigationMembers-8652` and `calendarNavigationMembers-8652` re-point their two "page warning" rows. Under a host that publishes `openRecord`, `mode: 'page'` and a mode-less `{ size: 'lg' }` each call it with `(object, '1')`, with no overlay and no `window.open`. Beside them: `drawer` under the same host is the lit control, a parent `onRowClick` takes the `page` click first (precedence control), and with no host navigator `page` opens nothing (the description's remaining claim). The parity ledger's two `pins` summaries follow.
- **New pins.** `useNavigationOverlay.hostRecordNavigator-11293` (react hooks) pins seven rows: `page`; mode-less; `onNavigate` wins; `onRowClick` wins; overlay lit control; absent `navigation` unchanged; no host or no object name. `PageView.recordNavigator-11293` (app-shell) pins that a block on the page reads a navigator, `openRecord` routes through the router, an unroutable object opens nothing, and `resolve` yields no handlers.

## Zone 2 measurements (dispatch order)

1. **Red reproduced first, at the mount** (test edits only, fix not yet written). Run: `pnpm exec vitest run` on the two `NavigationMembers-8652` files. Result: `Tests 4 failed | 27 passed (31)`. The 4 red rows are exactly `page` and mode-less on each block: `expected "vi.fn()" to be called 1 times, but got 0 times`. The `drawer` lit control, the parent-`onRowClick` control and the no-host row were green.
2. **How the grid wires it — premise partly falsified.** `ObjectGrid` has no record navigator of its own. Its hook call passes `onNavigate: onNavigate ?? schema.onNavigate`, which is host-supplied only (the console's `ObjectView`, `ObjectDataPage` and `InterfaceListPage` pass router closures). The only context navigator the grid reads is `RelatedRecordActionsContext.recordHref` / `openRecord`, for its link column. Measured with a throwaway probe, deleted before commit: a standalone `object-grid` with `navigation: { mode: 'page' }` and no `onNavigate` produced `open: 0, openRecord: [], pushState: 0, dialog: false`, with and without a provider. So "as the grid does" holds only when a host supplies the navigator, and the grid had the same dead click. The fix closes it for the grid too, and for the gallery, map, timeline and tree.
3. **Where the fallback lives: the shared hook.** `@object-ui/react` owns both the hook and `RelatedRecordActionsContext`, so reading the context adds no dependency. The hook therefore owns the `page` fallback, and the grid keeps its explicit wiring. The order's "no" branch (both renderers pass `onNavigate` the way the grid does) would not reach the standalone case: a block on a custom page is a document, nothing passes it a function, and the calendar's `onNavigate` prop already means date navigation. One measured gap remained: `PageView`, the host of standalone blocks on custom pages, published no navigator. The record page (`RelatedRecordActionsBridge`) and the list page (`listRecordActionsValue`) did. So the producer-side half lands here too, as the order allows ("if the real producer is elsewhere, fix it at the producer").
4. **"Page warning" rows** retired in both registrations' `inputs` and docblocks. Their pins are re-pointed as described above.
5. **A host that passes `onRowClick`** keeps its behaviour. This is pinned at both mounts under a host navigator, and in the hook test.

## Boundaries, stated

- **An absent `navigation` is unchanged.** Only an AUTHORED block that resolves to `page` reads the published navigator, and that limit is load-bearing. A host withholds navigation by passing neither callback: `RelatedList` renders mobile rows as an `object-gallery` with no `navigation`, and with `onRowClick` undefined when the bridge withheld `onView`. Reading the navigator on the absent-key path would open those records anyway. The hook test pins this row. `{}` and no config still agree whenever an `onNavigate` is supplied (the existing `modeDefault` rows stay green).
- **Modifier clicks and `new_window` are untouched.**
- **A side effect of publishing the navigator on custom pages:** the grid's link column and the lookup cells on a custom page now render real anchors, as they already do on the record and list pages. The `@object-ui/app-shell` changeset declares it.

## Tests (final runs on merged head `698710c094`; main merged at `cd5b19a7e7`)

- Build: `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/plugin-kanban^...' --filter '@object-ui/plugin-calendar^...' --filter '@object-ui/app-shell^...' build`. Then type-check: `pnpm --filter @object-ui/react --filter @object-ui/plugin-kanban --filter @object-ui/plugin-calendar --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check`. Each package ran `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`. Result: `type-check: Done` ×4, VERDICT command-exit 0. `--listFiles` on each `tsconfig.test.json` shows the touched test files are inside its scope.
- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/plugin-kanban/ packages/plugin-calendar/ packages/react/src/hooks/ apps/console/src/__tests__/registry-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts`. Result: `Test Files 160 passed (160)`, `Tests 1436 passed | 95 skipped (1531)`.
- One run covered two sets. (a) Every suite `git grep -l` finds for `useNavigationOverlay` or the 8652 pins, plus every suite that mounts `RelatedRecordActionsProvider` / `RelatedRecordActionsBridge` / `listRecordActionsValue` (58 files). (b) The app-shell `views` top-level suites, `views/__tests__`, and the suites that read `PageView.tsx`: the remount ratchet, `page-key-read-census`, `vite-declared-lazy-views`, `page-dom-leak-whitelist-7933`, `residue-namespaces-3546` (183 files). Result: `Test Files 231 passed (231)`, `Tests 2292 passed | 9 skipped (2301)`.
- Gates: `pnpm check:new-line-citations` (`0 new citation(s)`), `pnpm check:control-bytes` (OK), `pnpm changeset:check` (OK), `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` (OK, 4 changesets), `check:vi-mock-override-shape` / `check:vi-mock-inherit` / `check:vi-mock-specifiers` / `check:test-path-roots` (OK). `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` over the 19 paths: NOT GOVERNED.
- ESLint, narrowed to the 10 changed `.ts`/`.tsx` files (`--format json`): 0 errors. The warnings are all pre-existing. `PageView.tsx` carries 5 `no-explicit-any` at base and 5 now, and the kanban/calendar `index.tsx` changes are string-only. The narrowing is a measurement, not a skip: `eslint.config.js` enables no type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project` / `projectService`), and neither the config nor `eslint-rules/` reads other files from disk. So this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file.
- **Reverse verification (ablation)**, on the committed fix (`0919d4aa50`; the merge touched neither ablated file), through the anchor-must-hit `ablation-replace.mjs` with a verified restore:
  - Hook: the `openRecord(objectName, ...)` call was replaced (anchor 1 to 0, blob changed). Result: `Tests 6 failed | 32 passed (38)`, exactly the six `page` / mode-less rows (2 hook, 2 kanban, 2 calendar). Every control stayed green. Restored: blob equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
  - `PageView`: the provider `value` was replaced with `null`. Result: `Tests 2 failed | 3 passed (5)`, the two mount rows. The pure builder rows stayed green. Restored: blob equal to HEAD.
  - The tests resolve `@object-ui/react` through the root vitest alias to `src`. The ablation therefore exercised source, and needed no rebuild.
- NOT MEASURED: `check:sdui-registration-pins`, reason: it reads the console bundle (`PREREQUISITE`: build `@object-ui/console` first). `check:readme-exports`, reason: it needs every package's `dist` (the README edits are prose only, with no fenced imports). The console UI was not exercised in a browser.

## Acceptance notes (observations, not filed)

- The calendar's own `onEventClick` prop is not one of the hook's arms; only `onRowClick` is. So a React host that passes ONLY `onEventClick`, under a published navigator, now sees a `page` click navigate AND its callback fire. Measured producers of `onEventClick` on `ObjectCalendar` in this repo: zero (`git grep`), and the console passes none. Carrier: none.
- The kanban/calendar drawer's "open full page" link uses `deriveRecordPageHref`, which derives from `window.location`. On a custom page (`/apps/APP/page/NAME`) it would derive `/apps/APP/page/NAME/OBJECT/record/ID`. This is a read-only inference, not measured in the console. Carrier: none.
- The hook's `new_window` fallback with no `onNavigate` still opens an origin-rooted `/OBJECT/record/ID`, as the existing member pins assert. This PR leaves it untouched. Carrier: none.
- The pending `.changeset/8652-kanban-calendar-navigation.md` still says `page` opens nothing. It ships in the same release as these changesets, which state the new behaviour. It is another card's release note, so it was left as written.
